title: Print a Greeting
prompt:
Implement `void program(void)` that prints exactly:

```
Hello, Code Journey!
```

One line, ending with a newline.

tests.name: exact greeting
tests.code:
const char* out = cj_capture(program);
CHECK_STR_EQ(out, "Hello, Code Journey!\n");
tests.hint: printf the text once, with \n at the end.
